events.title: Challenger Colorado Second Saturday Science — Meet Me on Mars, Build & Launch a 3D-Printed Rocket
events.time: Saturday 9:00 AM–12:00 PM MST (America/Denver); 9:15, 9:45, 10:15, 10:45 and 11:15 AM planetarium time slots
events.location: Challenger Learning Center of Colorado, 8717 Wolf Valley Drive, Colorado Springs, CO 80924
events.cost: FREE — $0 per participant and $0 for family of five (if corresponding free planetarium slots remain available); parking/travel not specified
events.age: Public family activity for school-age children and parents/guardians; organizer does not publish a strict minimum age. Planetarium reservation required for each attendee, on official booking page.
events.description: Real hands-on aerospace activity co-sponsored by Challenger Learning Center and Space Foundation Discovery Center, specifically themed 'Meet Me on Mars': guests may assemble AND launch a 3D-printed rocket, explore Mars-themed STEM stations and attend a space-journey planetarium show. Explicitly all-family FREE ($0 for 5 people) with limited timed planetarium seats; official registration displayed free tickets across five showtimes at check, but remaining capacity is not guaranteed. Organizer warns rocket launch can be cancelled on short notice due to fire restrictions or permits; the free planetarium and STEM activities still have value. The organizer publishes Nov 14 2026, 9am to noon MST and exact Colorado Springs address. Monthly science series, but this date's limited hands-on rocket building/launching and free sponsored planetarium show distinguish it from ordinary classes, lectures or a routine admission-priced attraction. Applies to current Colorado residents in Nov 2026, not a confirmed 2027/28 event. Registration: https://www.challengercolorado.org/news-events/event-calendar.html/event-form/registration-form/117503/tickets
